verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a set of agent instruction packages (skills and plugins) that are installed into coding agents. It has no UI of its own, so asking whether its API matches its UI does not fit this kind of product. The evidence shows install commands and `yy` CLI usage inside the skills, but no UI and no API whose parity could be compared.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
